facts.fact: RMS Titanic sank in the early hours of 15 April 1912 after striking an iceberg, resulting in approximately 1,500 deaths.
Third Class accommodations on Titanic were better than many other ships of the time but still not as luxurious as First or Second Class.
Titanic carried 16 wooden lifeboats and 4 collapsible lifeboats, accommodating 1,178 people, only one-third of its total capacity.
During the sinking of the Titanic, most people who entered the −2 °C water died within 15–30 minutes due to cold shock and incapacitation.
Titanic sank after taking in so much water that buoyancy was lost, causing it to founder and eventually break apart.

sentences.text: What if you were on the Titanic as it sank? How would it feel?
The ship takes in so much water that it loses buoyancy and sinks.
You would panic as the structure breaks apart, cold water rushes in, and the freezing ocean claims you within minutes.
Would you have made it to one of the 16 lifeboats that saved only one-third of the passengers?
